description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to the Calendar module in a CRM system, handling UI interactions such as setting date values, toggling time options, switching assignment types, viewing activities, and importing/exporting calendar data.

methods.name: set_values(form)
methods.description: Sets date and time input fields based on the state of a checkbox, updating UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: toggleTime()
methods.description: Toggles the enablement of duration fields based on the 'notime' checkbox.

methods.name: toggleAssignType(currType)
methods.description: Switches the display between user and team assignment sections based on the selected type.

methods.name: showActivityView(selectactivity_view)
methods.description: Reloads the page to display a specific activity view based on user selection.

methods.name: exportCalendar()
methods.description: Exports the calendar in iCal format by constructing a download URL and initiating navigation.

methods.name: importCalendar()
methods.description: Handles iCalendar file import, validating the file extension and submitting the import form.
